claim.purpose: Add a typed fail-closed recovery for stale approved design inputs in initialized records

initial.title: Recover stale approved design in initialized records
initial.goal: Restore a legal typed lifecycle path when approved authored design inputs change before readiness.
initial.required_outcome: Initialized approved records can refresh stale design projections atomically without hand edits or gate bypass.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Stale initialized-approved design cannot reach ready before recovery
AC-2: Typed recovery validates CAS, active claim, reviewer, and actual stale authored inputs
AC-3: Recovery atomically refreshes SPP/VPP digests and audit truth
AC-4: Doctor passes and ready transition succeeds after recovery
initial.failure_policy: Fail closed without exact stale-input, CAS, claim, and reviewer evidence.
initial.plan_summary: Detect stale authored digests during initialized approved state, permit exact typed reapproval, and prove normal readiness resumes.

steps.action: Implement initialized stale-design reapproval and focused regression

validation_lanes.proof_role: Typed lifecycle and atomic card recovery

review_prompts: Is recovery limited to truly stale initialized-approved inputs?
Are CAS, claim, atomicity, and readiness gates preserved?
risks: Over-broad reapproval could hide unrelated card corruption.
stop_conditions: Any need to hand-edit rendered cards
initial.task_boundary: Implement only the typed initialized stale-design recovery and its focused regression.
